title: GeneratedKnowledge
description: The knowledge the generator emits with the manifest (`oui-knowledge.json`), from the same declarations: the map of the app, every page in full with its relationships and recipes, and the app's frame. No word of it is written by hand. Each turn carries the part for the page the person is on (`resolveKnowledge`): the map, the frame parts around that page, the page in full, and one paragraph for each adjacent page.

buildId.description: The manifest's build id: the two are one build.

overview.description: The app's map: every page and room, how to reach it (its sidebar group, or the page and the controls that lead to it), and what it offers, as capability groups from its bound actions and its rooms' menus. Fitted to the config's mapChars, and the same for every page of a build, so the assistant always has it.

map.description: The app's map line by line, present only when a route of the build is gated (`routeGates`): `overview.content` is these lines with every page shown. A tab given what the session may see (`allows`) renders them without the pages it may not (`appMapContent`), so the map names only pages the person can open. The generator places a page under another only when that page is open whenever this one is, so no line is left under a page that is gone.

frames.description: The app's frame around the pages (`shell` surfaces), each part with the route patterns it frames.

KnowledgeEntry.description: One block of knowledge, as the assistant's prompt shows it.

AppMapLine.description: One line of the app's map.

oneOf.description: A line shown whatever the session may see: the map's opening, the app's frame, how to go to a page.
A heading over the page lines that follow it (a sidebar group, the pages opened by address): shown when one of them is.

One page's line: its depth in two spaces each, then `- <title> <route>`, then ` (from <from>)` when it has one, then `: <says>` and ` <offers>` when it says what it is for, else `: <offers>` when it offers something. Shown when its page is open to the session, naming the first of the page's open routes when `route` is not open.

depth.description: How far it is indented: one more than the page that opens it.

route.description: The route it names: its page's first.

from.description: The control on the page above it that opens it.

says.description: What the page tells the assistant it is for, apart from what the screen shows (its component's `@agentDescription`): its first sentence. Only on the page's own line, so a session that may not see the page is never told it.

offers.description: What it offers, as the map was fitted to `mapChars`.

KnowledgeRecipe.description: A task recipe the UI implies, as the assistant's prompt shows a workflow.

PageKnowledge.description: What the assistant knows of one page, or one part of the app's frame.

summary.description: One paragraph: what the page is for, for when the user is elsewhere.

detail.description: Everything the page and its rooms offer, where each thing is, and its parameters.

relationships.description: Relationships derived from types: which fields apply to what, which animate, what leads where.

adjacent.description: Page surfaces this page leads to or is reached from.

gates.description: Its gated routes, each with its gates, as its manifest surface has them. Absent when none of its routes is gated.
